items.quote: As a PDR technician, PDR Kalk makes my work enormously easier. The software is clear, professionally structured and saves a lot of time every day when calculating hail and parking damage. I particularly appreciate the simple operation, the clean creation of reports and invoices, and the reliable calculations. You can tell immediately that it was developed by someone who knows the PDR trade from hands-on experience. Support is fast and competent. A clear recommendation for anyone who wants to work professionally and efficiently.
items.name: Florian Huber

items.quote: In my view, PDR Kalk is the best hail and parking damage calculation software on the market. It impresses with extremely simple, intuitive operation and is available for both Windows and Android — ideal for flexible use in the office and on the road. Calculations can be created quickly and clearly, sent digitally straight away and seamlessly converted into invoices. A particular strength is the ability to cleanly divide work and let several technicians work together as subcontractors in one system, keeping full transparency over services, billing and responsibilities at all times. PDR Kalk saves an enormous amount of time, reduces errors and ensures a professional, structured workflow — from damage assessment to billing. For hail and parking damage businesses it's a real asset and hard to work without. A clear recommendation.
items.name: Jürg Strähl

items.quote: This professional calculation app helps businesses estimate parking and hail damage on vehicles quickly, precisely and without fuss. It impresses with its particularly simple operation and enables efficient damage capture. Stored lists of various insurers make processing even easier and ensure a structured, practical workflow. Thanks to pre-stored items, calculations can be created quickly and tailored individually, and you can add your own notes for special requirements. The result is a mature, professional product that reliably and effectively supports digital damage calculation.
items.name: Sandro Sciuto

items.quote: Very good app with simple, clear operation. The functions are well thought out and make daily work noticeably easier. I find the ability to work with subcontractors and team members particularly practical. All in all, a reliable and professional solution. A clear recommendation!
items.name: Dominik Nagy

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What workshops most often want to know before they buy.

items.q: How long is the licence valid?
items.a: It is a one-time licence: paid once, with no expiry date and no monthly fees. The “about AUD $10 per month” figure is only an illustration spread over five years — nothing falls due afterwards.
AUD $590 as a one-time payment, GST applies and is itemised on your tax invoice. No setup fee, no running costs and no per-tech fees.

{days} days with the full feature set, a direct download with no sign-up and no credit card. The trial ends by itself. On first start there is a one-off online activation (technical data only, see the privacy notice); after that the app works offline. One trial per device.

items.q: How do I buy a licence?
items.a: Through the “Order a licence” form. The order is binding; you usually receive the tax invoice by email within 24 hours, payable by bank transfer within {paymentDays} days — no credit card needed. Once payment arrives you receive your licence details and unlock PDR Kalk with them.
Minor updates are included. Optional insurance or tariff list updates may attract a small fee. What is new is shown under “What's new” in the app.

items.q: Which devices does PDR Kalk run on?
items.a: Windows 10 and 11 (PC, laptop or Windows tablet from 10 inches) and Android tablets from Android 10. Apple devices and smartphones are not supported; a phone only supplies photos to the job via QR code.

items.q: Can I work on several devices?
items.a: Yes. Windows devices sync through a shared work folder (NAS, OneDrive, Synology Drive). Android tablets run standalone with the full feature set. Settings → Storage shows when the other devices were last active.

items.q: How many users or technicians are included?
items.a: Unlimited users per licence and no cost per technician. Technicians can be assigned per panel. Subcontractors and partner workshops work in their own installation and therefore need their own licence.
100 % locally on your device or in your own work folder (NAS). There is no vendor cloud and no telemetry. The internet is only needed for the trial activation and for sending email.

items.q: How do I back up my data?
items.a: With a full backup as a ZIP, with or without photos. The smart restore merges rather than duplicates. Each job also has a job package ZIP containing all of its documents.
Every change is recorded in a SHA-256 hash chain; document versions and PDF snapshots are created automatically on every status change. The audit trail can be exported as JSON and verified.

items.q: Is PDR Kalk set up for Australia?
items.a: Yes. AUD, GST at 10 %, tax invoices and receipts with your ABN, and hail estimating per panel, per vehicle, by triage tier or by the hour. Dent damage can be quoted per panel, at a flat rate or by the hour.

items.q: What kind of invoices can I create?
items.a: GST tax invoices with your logo and ABN, receipts, credit notes, split invoices, cancellation invoices with a replacement and manual invoices without a report. Payments can be recorded including part payments; for bookkeeping there are CSV and Excel exports, including open receivables.

items.q: Which languages is PDR Kalk available in?
items.a: The app interface is in English for Australia and is available in {languages} languages in total. Since version {version} the document language can also be chosen freely — invoices, reports and emails go out in the customer's language, independent of the app language.
The app contains a searchable user manual with step-by-step guides for every area. On top of that there is email support at info@pdrkalk.ch — an answer usually arrives within 24 hours.

order.title: Order a licence
order.lead: Place a binding order for your PDR Kalk one-time licence here. You receive the tax invoice by email and pay by bank transfer; the licence follows once payment has arrived.

items.d: By clicking “Place binding order” you place a binding order for a PDR Kalk licence. Sales are to business customers only (B2B).
AUD $590, GST applies and is itemised on your tax invoice.
You receive the tax invoice by email. It is payable by bank transfer within {paymentDays} days of the invoice date.
The licence is issued once payment has been received in full and is sent to you by email.
A one-time licence with no expiry date and no subscription, for commercial use by one business. It may be installed and used on any number of the licensee's devices.
The licence is permanently tied to the business and address given in the order. The business name and address cannot be changed after issue, and the licence cannot be transferred to another business.

PDR Kalk can be tested free of charge and without obligation for {days} days before purchase. There are therefore no refunds for change of mind. This does not affect your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
Regular updates are included free of charge. Larger add-on modules may be offered optionally for a small fee; buying them is voluntary.

Any built-in AI features are optional, may not be available in every region and may rely on evolving AI services. They require your own API key from the chosen provider; setup and costs are the customer's responsibility. Availability, accuracy and behaviour are not guaranteed.
Swiss law applies. The place of jurisdiction is Schaffhausen, Switzerland.
